summary.headline: Astrological Judgments and Star Configurations
summary.text: Catalog entries 47–64 of a Venetian astrological codex, covering omens of terrestrial and aerial signs, war and enemies, illness and death, weather, commerce, rain and drought, changing winds, country-sign correspondences, stellar configurations, great-star conjunctions, exaltations and depressions, the ascending node, and star risings. Authorities include Persian and Arab astrologers, Maseris, Muchamates the Palchiote, and Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos.
